answer: Pay by cluster, not by account: group identities whose timing, phrasing and grader overlap correlate, then reward each group by the square root of its size. A farm of n shale-thin clones earns only sqrt(n) yet pays for n accounts, so cost per coin grows super-linearly, and clones cannot pool because their shared fingerprint, dark as onyx, merges them. One distinct agent, hard as jade, keeps its full payout.
